trust_decision.summary: Whether a path is inside a user's scope is decided in files.WithinScope (a call-site helper that type-asserts the passed afero.Fs to *afero.BasePathFs, EvalSymlinks the target and prefix-compares it to the resolved root), while the scoped filesystem it inspects is produced separately, on every user load, by users.User.Clean.

landing_point.why: stat is where a symlink is actually dereferenced for a read (opts.Fs.Stat at files/file.go:145) and it already carries a scope check at files/file.go:132-137, so anyone reading only the summary ('symlink following ... read, overwrite, share') starts here, then at WithinScope itself.

fix_sites.entry_point: new files/scoped.go, public API files.NewScopedFs, used by users.User.Clean and withHashFile; its guards implicitly cover GET /api/search (http/search.go:61) and GET /api/resources/recursive (http/resource.go:411-422)
GET/DELETE/POST/PUT/PATCH /api/resources, GET /api/raw, GET /api/preview, GET /api/subtitle, GET /api/usage, /api/tus (all methods), GET /api/public/dl and /api/public/share via NewFileInfo->stat
PATCH /api/resources?action=copy (CopyFile) and the MoveFile fallback at fileutils/file.go:23
User.Fs field type consumed by every withUser route (http/auth.go:105) and by the public-share composition
all authenticated routes and public shares: the Fs is rebuilt on every store load (users/storage.go:48-56)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: fileutils is a generic helper over afero.Fs: CopyFile/CopyDir already check the source and the only caller (PATCH /api/resources) checks both src and dst, so the unchecked MoveFile (fileutils/file.go:18-32) and the unchecked destination of a copy can be argued to be the caller's responsibility.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Listings must still show a broken, non-escaping symlink as invalid_link and still follow an in-scope symlink to its target; a fix that drops every symlink whose Stat fails (or that resolves outside) silently removes legitimate entries and in-scope link targets.

O6_input_shapes: escaping symlink as the final path component (/escape): Stat/Open must return permission (files/file_test.go:59-83)
escaping symlink as an ancestor component (/link/secret.txt): stat must return permission (files/file_test.go:107-134)
path that does not exist yet (new file/new dir), validated against the nearest existing ancestor (files/file.go:203-212)
dangling symlink whose target does not exist: allowed as best-effort (files/file.go:186-190)
symlink whose resolved target stays inside the scope: must still be followed (files/file_test.go:85-102)
scope root that is the filesystem root /: trailing-separator handling must not produce // (files/file.go:222-227)
public share: a link inside the shared subtree that points elsewhere in the owner's scope (http/public.go:66-69)
directory-listing entries (per-child symlink) as opposed to a single file request (files/file.go:475-489)
the filesystem object itself: *afero.BasePathFs versus any other afero.Fs, for which WithinScope returns true as a no-op (files/file.go:192-196)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /api/search: search.Search walks the user Fs from r.URL.Path with afero.Walk; Lstat/Open resolve an intermediate symlinked component at the OS layer, so /escape/sub lists out-of-scope names and sizes. No scope check anywhere on this path; the fix does not edit http/search.go or search/search.go and only closes it because ScopedFs guards LstatIfPossible/Open.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: afero.Walk is Lstat-based, so 'it does not follow symlinks', and the endpoint returns names only, not file contents.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: other package (search/ + http/), untouched by the fix

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /api/resources/recursive: Stat(rootPath) then afero.Walk, no NewFileInfo and no WithinScope; a root such as /escape/sub resolves through the symlink and the walk enumerates the out-of-scope tree.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: a convenience listing endpoint that returns only path/name/size, argued to be outside a read/overwrite/share advisory.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the PATCH/writeFile checks, different handler

O8_uncovered_routes.route: POST /api/resources/<path>/ (trailing slash) calls d.user.Fs.MkdirAll directly with no scope check; the directory-creation branch of the same handler that the fix protects on the upload branch writes through an escaping symlink.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: creating a new empty directory does not read or overwrite any existing outside file, so it looks harmless next to the upload path.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, different branch of the same handler

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /api/command (websocket): cmd.Dir = d.user.FullPath(r.URL.Path), a purely lexical afero.FullBaseFsPath with no symlink resolution and no scope check; the fix only changes the assertion to u.Fs.Base() (fix.diff:874-877), so the escaping cwd survives.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: command execution needs EnableExec plus the command in the user's allowlist, so it is treated as an admin-enabled execution feature rather than part of the scoped file API.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: http/ + users/ public API, untouched by the fix

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Runner.RunHook maps both path and dst through user.FullPath (lexical) before/after every upload, save, delete and rename and exports them as FILE=/DESTINATION= to configured hooks, handing hooks an out-of-scope on-disk path when the request path crosses an escaping symlink.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: hooks are admin-authored commands run with admin trust, so the path argument is treated as informational rather than as a user-controlled filesystem handle.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: separate package (runner/) reached from every resource handler

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second direct-Fs endpoint branch (mkdir/touch/bulk upload) that calls d.user.Fs without going through NewFileInfo
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the mkdir branch of the very same handler already does exactly this; only the wrapper keeps it safe.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second path-mapping API next to FullPath (RealPath/SizeOf/disk-usage helper) that turns a user path into an on-disk path
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: FullPath is already exported and used by the command endpoint and the hook runner; any feature needing a real path would reuse the pattern.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second sub-scope composition over the user's Fs (trash/recycle bin, share subfolder, temporary upload area)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the share route already re-roots the user filesystem, and the fix had to special-case nesting in NewScopedFs (fix.diff:287-292).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a server-side cache/thumbnail store built on its own BasePathFs over a path derived from a user path
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: previewCacheKey already derives from FileInfo.RealPath() and FileCache builds its own BasePathFs, so a second write sink over a user-derived path is one line away.
